title: Cash bhejne pe RBI ka naya ₹5,000 lock

source.title: Reserve Bank of India (Domestic Money Transfer) Directions, 2026

hook.caption: UPI ke zamane mein bhi agar aap ya aapki family cash money transfer karti hai — RBI ka naya ₹5,000 lock rule turant jaan lo.
hook.tts: UPI के ज़माने में भी अगर आप या आपकी family cash money transfer करती है, तो RBI का नया पाँच हज़ार रुपये का lock rule तुरंत जान लो.

doc.name: RBI (Domestic Money Transfer) Directions, 2026
doc.caption: Official document: RBI/DPSS/2026-27/476 — Domestic Money Transfer Directions, 2026. Effective immediately.
doc.tts: यह official RBI notification 11 November 2026 को जारी हुआ है, जो सभी banks और payment operators पर लागू है.

points.title: Cash Pay-out: ₹10,000/tx, ₹25,000/month
points.quote: The maximum amount that may be transferred under the Cash Pay-out Service shall be ₹10,000 per transaction, subject to an overall monthly ceiling of ₹25,000 per beneficiary.
points.decoded: Bina bank account cash delivery pe ₹10,000/tx aur ₹25,000/month cap
points.caption: Point 1: Account se bina-bank-account wale recipient ko cash bhejne pe ₹10,000 per transaction aur ₹25,000 monthly ceiling.
points.tts: पहला point. Account से बिना bank account वाले recipient को cash भेजने पर दस हज़ार प्रति transaction और पच्चीस हज़ार monthly limit है.

points.title: Branch vs BC Agent: 10x Limit Gap
points.quote: A walk-in customer at a bank branch can remit funds up to ₹50,000 to the bank account of a beneficiary through NEFT. Banks are also permitted to allow such customers to transfer funds to a bank account of a beneficiary through Business Correspondents (BCs), ATMs, etc., up to a maximum amount of ₹5,000 per transaction with a monthly cap of ₹25,000 per remitter.
points.decoded: Twist: Branch NEFT ₹50,000, par BC/ATM pe sirf ₹5,000/tx
points.caption: Point 2 (Twist): Bank branch se walk-in NEFT ₹50,000 tak allowed hai, par BC agent ya ATM se sirf ₹5,000 per transaction aur ₹25,000 monthly cap!
points.tts: पर असली twist यहाँ है. Bank branch से walk-in NEFT पचास हज़ार तक allowed है, पर BC agent या ATM से सिर्फ पाँच हज़ार प्रति transaction की limit है.

points.title: Mandatory KYC, AFA & Velocity Checks
points.quote: Every transaction undertaken by a remitter shall be validated by an Additional Factor of Authentication (AFA). Banks and non-banks, as applicable, shall put in place robust systems of safeguards, including velocity checks and alerts to customers regarding credits into accounts using the facilities provided under these Directions.
points.decoded: Har cash transfer pe verified mobile + OVD KYC + AFA + velocity alert
points.caption: Point 3: Har cash pay-in ke liye verified mobile, OVD KYC aur Additional Factor of Authentication zaroori hai — saath mein real-time velocity checks.
points.tts: तीसरा point. हर cash transfer के लिए verified mobile, OVD KYC और Additional Factor of Authentication ज़रूरी है, साथ में real-time fraud alerts भी.

lines: Har transaction pe AFA + RBI Ombudsman cover
Kya ₹25,000 monthly cap kaafi hai? Comment karo
asar.caption: Aap par asar: Agar aapka koi relative cash remittance use karta hai, toh unhe yeh video abhi bhejo aur comment mein batao — kya ₹25,000 monthly cap kaafi hai?
asar.tts: आप पर असर. अगर आपका कोई relative cash remittance use करता है, तो उन्हें यह video अभी भेजो और comment में बताओ — क्या पच्चीस हज़ार monthly limit काफी है?

outro.caption: Poora breakdown YouTube par, slides Instagram par — aur agar aap sochte ho cash transfer khatam ho gaya, toh dekho...
outro.tts: पूरा breakdown YouTube पर, slides Instagram पर — और अगर आप सोचते हो cash transfer खत्म हो गया, तो...
